dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Aggregated from 14 datasets including AHEPAAD, TUMCP, BASEL, UNMPD, CREAPARK, turkeyAD, turkeyPDAD, lebAD2017, lebAD2019, UMHC, UHTPD, WCHC, SRM, DIH
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Data was gathered from 14 distinct spontaneous EEG studies... The data were aggregated from 14 distinct studies... A detailed overview of the datasets... is provided in Supplementary Data 1.

answer.MULTI-DATASET (UNSPECIFIED OR N>=10): normative training (HC) / testing (HC) and clinical evaluation (PD, AD)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative models were trained on 400 HC participants (pooled from the 14 datasets). 99 HC participants were held out as a comparison group. Clinical groups (PD, AD) from the datasets were projected onto the models.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Normative models were trained on 400 (46% M) HC participants while 99 (42% M) HC participants were held out as a comparison group against the clinical cohort. The clinical groups comprised 237 PD patients (65% M), and 197 AD patients (37% M).
